scope:
Recovery of fixed allocation/depth-scope experiments, only Agent sources/data.
No raw Slack/account/private inputs. Replay saved full histories and actual
reply witnesses from the final ZIP, not a working file. Recovery is not an
independent WDL/scientific certificate or renewed unexposed qualification.

games.scope:
Describe all fixed cells and caller costs; no default/strength claim.
Ongoing64, technical unknown and real draws are kept distinct. Mixed trajectories
do not support paired-speed estimates. Completed Core depth and resolved prepass
outcomes stay separate, as do successor work units and alpha-beta nodes.

paired.scope:
Common-parent allocation diagnostic, no whole-root WDL or Elo.
Count each identical full-history/leaf parent once, retain all sampled paths.
Opposing next-reply witnesses concern selected children only. Absence is a
one-step local observation, not overall safety or proof of optimality.

reply.scope:
Describe every selected-child reply diagnostic. Positive rows and unique
complete states are separate; no forced/avoidable error rate or independent
holdout claim. Preserve method/leaf/resource/actual completed-depth context.

coverage.scope:
Whole frozen prospective cohort's saved prepass coverage, no reruns/refits.
Root/reply/deeper materialized successors are disjoint accounting levels.
Tie records describe heuristic concentration, never independent move utility.
This asks whether a new coverage premise is motivated before any new policy.

dependency.scope:
Keep action-sequence repetition separate from full-state repetition.
Leaf/method crossover rows share four rule samples; unique paths are not
independent trials or training samples. No outcomes or conditions changed.

work.scope:
Actual recorded public/runtime work, not nodes mislabeled as transition cost.
Native/terminal internal semantic pushes were not instrumented in these games;
the saved materialization/generation/cache/scoring counters retain their names.
Caller time includes the wrapper and PV validation, game-record bytes separate.
work.prepass_scope: Materialized full-state successors/evaluations/generations retained in analysis.json; terminal internal transition count unmeasured, no inferred count.

resolutions.scope:
Describe ALL eight actual resolutions against already saved cold Core calls
at identical full-state/leaf roots across swapped owners. No additional search,
outcome selection, label refit or missing-match inference. Terminal versus
nonterminal selected child and current-mover outcome remain distinct.

paired_cost_routes.scope:
Separate resolved shortcuts from unknown-call opportunity cost on ALL paired
parents. Existing Core mate signs versus prepass outcomes are recorded, not
inferred from missing calls. No searches, selective extensions or new labels.

saved_branch_analysis.scope:
Changed question on exposed saved trials: where was root-relative work spent?
No search rerun, cap extension, source intervention or exposed policy fitting.
Root child counts reveal only first reply layer, not full tree depth/work.

drop_responses.scope:
Exposed response-support diagnostic, no score/fit/default. Ask which actual
legal response distinguishes the same checking drop on safe/adverse children.
Use all five saved children and same common A[5,7] drop, all full histories.
Measure streamed first response and full actual responses separately; absence of
responses relies on Core terminal authority, never check counts alone.
Expected<1min; run after timed jobs so extraction cannot contaminate timings.
